title: Review of c55's nonlocal-oscillator (chimera field) negative on fresh seed 44: alpha 1.1 ends in a coherent wave with no incoherent bodies, alpha 1.25 stays in spiral turbulence whose incoherent regions (1-6, 65% of the box) never persist
summary: Labkit runs of the finding's world.py (smooth random initial phases, init 1, R 6) on seed 44, 128^2, 150 frames x 100 steps (t=1500), matter = incoherence 1-|Z|. alpha 1.1: 64 tracks, longest 10 frames (100 t), 0 components at the end (coherent). alpha 1.25: spiral turbulence (sheet t=60-1500); 168 tracks, longest 100 t, 0 persistent tracks, 57 splits against 42 merges, 0 persistent splits; 1-6 components covering 65% of the box at the end.

observations.I: rerun/seed44_alpha1.25/FACTS.md: 0 persistent tracks, longest 100 t, occupancy 0.65; rerun/seed44_alpha1.1/FACTS.md: 0 components at t=1500

controls_run.I: rerun/seed44_alpha1.1 (the coherent side of the alpha scan)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and two alpha values.
